name: Mummy’s Jewels

features.name: Eye of Ra collector
features.description: Reel-one collector awards adjacent money symbols.

features.name: Coloured wild features
features.description: Purple, green and red wilds trigger Upgrade, Extra and Respins.

review:
An Egyptian collect game. The Eye of Ra lands on reel one and collects neighbouring money symbols, and coloured wilds collected above the reels switch on features.

Purple upgrades money values on the prize wheel, green adds more prizes, and red starts 5 to 50 respins where only collectors and money symbols land, with a multiplier up to 10x. Colours can combine for stronger effects. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
